transport: Same-origin GET /api/usuario/privacidad/exportar using the existing authenticated Api request/refresh flow. Fixed page size 100, cursor whitelist only; UUID strings are validated without case normalization.
pagination: One user action prepares one downloadable part. The backend always returns five collections; the client omits previously finished collections from later files and omits their request cursors. Account and subscription snapshots appear only in part 1.

download_format.collections: Only collections still pending before this request; each contains records. Manifest records each collection page, completion state, per-part count and cumulative count. No technical continuation cursor is rendered or copied into the manifest.
download_format.scope: Backend scope is retained in every part, including excluded categories, legacy content caveats and live-keyset consistency.

truthful_states: Preparing without a percentage while the total number of parts is unknown
Part prepared only after Blob URL and anchor click execute; this is not confirmation that a user saved the file
Explicit next part and restart controls; final status only after every included collection reaches null next_after
End of pages remains separate from legacy plan bodies requiring authorized review
Errors preserve prior successful counts and continuation; no new part is counted or downloaded
Real identity revalidated before each part and re-download; mismatched or stale in-flight responses are discarded after account/session changes
memory_and_cleanup: No export payload or cursor in localStorage/sessionStorage. Retain only one last-part Blob, cumulative counts and bounded cursor history; never concatenate all exported records. Object URLs are revoked after 2 seconds, and immediately on pagehide. Restart/account changes clear export state; pending URLs finish their short cleanup margin.
accessibility: Native buttons, aria-busy/progress, live status, focused error region and responsive actions. Scoped axe AA covers the new section at four widths plus error; whole-page horizontal overflow was checked. This does not claim a full legacy profile accessibility audit or a screen-reader test.

validation.flow: Real synthetic historical professional exports 3 parts with 1 personal profile, 205 unique plans, 2 measurements, 102 purchases and 101 generation requests. One legacy plan requires content review. UUID continuation preserves uppercase characters. Finished collections and first-part metadata are omitted correctly.
negatives: Unauthenticated 401 and revoked-session redirect without download
503, 200 HTML and incomplete JSON do not prepare files
Non-progressing continuation is rejected without losing confirmed counts
Mismatched response account and real account switch reset continuation/file
Old authenticated response arriving after a cross-tab session change is discarded
validation.test_doubles: Only negative export responses and a response-delivery delay are intercepted; authentication, account identity, scope and normal export requests are real. Export JSON is read only from temporary browser download files and is not copied into evidence.

environment: Dedicated loopback server 8768, own temporary SQLite, provider keys removed and external sockets blocked before product imports; browser aborts non-local requests. No production data, email delivery, provider or deployment.
remaining: General R31 retention/erasure/legal policies are not created by this export UI
R14 persistence and browser-local diary remain separate; binary files and professional portfolio are excluded by the reviewed backend contract
